the being its root, Kām. xvi, 37.

pl. N. of a people, MBh. vi, 371
posterity, family, race, offspring, child (‘grandchild’, opposed to तोक॑, ‘child’, Nir. x, 7; xii, 6), RV.; VarBṛS. (ifc. f(आ). , ciii, 1 f.)
